info.title: LFen's Second Brain — C1/C3 foundation
info.description: Stage 1 A contract. Native authentication and dataset/document/file identities are reused. All registered domains are owner-only and catalogue-only. Keys, temporary sharing, semantic retrieval, parsing, graph edges and memory/persona are not implemented here. JSON bodies max 16 KiB; case-sensitive unknown or repeated JSON fields, repeated/unknown queries and extra JSON values are rejected. Malformed query encoding and explicit empty numeric query values are rejected. Root group parent_id is null; list root children by omitting parent_id. Cursors are scope-bound pagination state, not credentials. Every page is reauthorized. Native middleware errors may keep native envelopes.

NativeSession.name: Authorization
NativeSession.description: Use the existing RAGFlow authenticated user session header verbatim; do not prepend Bearer unless required by your native deployment. This is not a temporary domain grant. Never distribute owner/provider keys.

relative_path.description: Normalized relative POSIX path, at most 512 characters in total and 256 characters in its basename.

not_implemented: C4 retrieval, evidence and reuse packages
x-knowledge-frozen.consistency: Critical catalogue writes serialize on the domain row. Native folder commits and source snapshots share a folder row lock, read the latest head with a locking read, and assign increasing commit timestamps. Native object writes precede DB publication and can leave an unreferenced immutable blob after rollback. Lists are weakly consistent; exact revision content is immutable and hash-verified.

source_import.sequence: Create empty native dataset without embedding_model, register domain, then upload synthetic UTF-8 file and snapshot explicitly.
source_import.native_create_caution: Providing embedding_model performs local model configuration, permission, catalogue and driver resolution; it does not execute embedding or remote inference. The minimal foundation flow omits model selection.
source_import.constraints: The registered-domain upload adapter preserves original filename/bytes, requires valid UTF-8 without NUL, and caps files at 2 MiB. No PDF/PPT/OCR, Git watching or automatic indexing in this contract.
source_import.revision_scope: Snapshots observe the native Document payload plus classification. File editor changes and external file changes are not automatically synchronized. A future incremental producer must reuse Document.ID for the same logical source.

x-knowledge-frozen.domain_registration: Requires an empty private dataset without Connector links or ingestion history. Existing registered domains replay idempotently for the same category.
x-knowledge-frozen.native_model_settings: Registered domains reject embd_id/embedding_model updates. Native creation before registration may resolve a supplied model locally; this check is not remote inference. The minimal setup omits embedding_model.
x-knowledge-frozen.native_file_links: Native File links involving registered-domain targets, files currently linked to registered domains, or versioned knowledge sources are denied. Tenant metadata browsing excludes unauthorized domain folders/files before pagination, recursive search, ancestor reads and aggregates. This contract supports Dataset multipart upload only.
x-knowledge-frozen.native_folder_binding: Registered domains persist a unique native upload Folder ID in the registration transaction. Renames preserve the binding; native moves/deletes of managed sources or ancestor trees are rejected before mutation. Native name-based upload, initialization, version resolution, deduplication and deletion exclude managed folder IDs. Older multiple source folders retain their original revision addresses; new uploads choose the current-name candidate, otherwise the smallest ID. Unclaimed native source folders are visible only to their creator; their original domain is not inferred from names. Legacy unregistered datasets remain unbound. Startup migration freezes unclaimed legacy folder ownership in internal File.KnowledgePrivateOwnerID; subsequent links or renames cannot clear it. Ordinary name lookups exclude unclaimed folders. The reserved-name exception applies only to the common container directly under the real tenant root. Folders with existing ordinary document links and no registered/historical/marked origin cannot be retrospectively classified from names.
x-knowledge-frozen.native_source_provenance: Explicit current/historical File-Document-SourceRevision links impose every source owner restriction in addition to native authorization. Existing ordinary target copies cannot grant readers access or enable model calls, ingestion queues or embedding availability probes. Dataset list predicates apply before count/pagination; unrelated ordinary sources preserve native behavior. This does not detect arbitrary manual copy/paste. Folder owner restrictions propagate through persisted File.ParentID descendants, including raw files; authorization, browsing, transfers, target datasets and model use share this constraint. This does not add raw-file import support to C1.
x-knowledge-frozen.native_commit_scope: Native commit batches authorize every existing File in the same tenant and persisted URL folder subtree before any object or version write; managed source/tree deletion cannot bypass lifecycle guards via a commit. Pre-existing ordinary native version delete references an absent File.status column and remains unsupported in this delivery; full deletion/retention is deferred to stage 2.
x-knowledge-frozen.native_background_policy: CREATED recovery, persisted task loading and execution, the production embedding resolver, dirty Wiki compilation and dataset completion consumers re-evaluate C3 before parsers, model dependencies or content processing. Previously queued work and ordinary target copies are not exemptions.
x-knowledge-frozen.native_domain_retirement: DELETE /datasets logically archives registered domains under a Knowledgebase row lock with current actor authorization: status=0, all domain/folder/document/mapping/revision/object and model restrictions retained. Active catalogue hides the domain; old copies and queued work remain restricted. No restore or physical purge in v1. Ordinary unregistered datasets retain native deletion.
